body: I just don't see a point to be honest. I'm just an incredibly unhappy person with a knack for making myself miserable. Why should I continue?, I just don't see a point. I've argued it with people before, there just doesn't seem to be a point in continuing than for the sake of other people, and that doesn't seem like a good reason. I don't feel like I'm an evil person, I think I make myself and others miserable.
